power-converter.quickAnswer: Enter the power value, choose the unit you have and the one you want. The tool converts instantly using standard definitions — 1 mechanical horsepower equals 745.699872 watts and 1 metric horsepower (PS) equals 735.49875 watts.
keyFacts: The watt is the SI unit of power: one joule of energy transferred per second.
One mechanical (imperial) horsepower is defined as exactly 745.7 watts.
One metric horsepower (PS, Pferdestärke) equals 735.49875 watts.
The kilowatt-hour (kWh) measures energy, not power — 1 kW running for 1 hour.
One BTU per hour equals about 0.293 watts, common in air-conditioner ratings.
howTo: Type the power value into the value field.
Pick the source unit from the "From" dropdown.
Pick the target unit from the "To" dropdown.
Read the result instantly; tap swap to reverse the conversion.
Check the conversion rate line to see the exact factor used.
power-converter.formula:
result = value × (from-unit in watts) ÷ (to-unit in watts)
Example: kW = hp × 745.699872 ÷ 1000
power-converter.workedExample:
Convert 100 horsepower to kilowatts.
Step 1: 100 hp in watts = 100 × 745.699872 = 74569.9872 W.
Step 2: 1 kW = 1000 W.
Step 3: 74569.9872 ÷ 1000 = 74.569987.
Answer: 100 hp = 74.569987 kW.
benefits: Distinguishes imperial horsepower from metric PS — a common source of error.
Covers household (mW, W), industrial (kW, MW) and engine (hp, PS) scales.
Shows the exact conversion rate alongside the result.
Useful for car specs, appliances, generators and HVAC sizing.
limitations: Horsepower has several historical definitions; this tool uses mechanical hp and metric PS.
It converts power units only — kWh (energy) is a different quantity.
Results are rounded to 6 decimal places.
Values beyond ±1e15 are clamped for safety.

faqs.a: One mechanical horsepower is 745.699872 watts (about 0.746 kW). One metric horsepower (PS) is 735.49875 watts — slightly less.

faqs.q: What is the difference between hp and PS?
faqs.a: Mechanical hp (imperial) is defined as 550 foot-pounds per second = 745.7 W. Metric PS (Pferdestärke) is 75 kilogram-metres per second = 735.5 W. Car brochures in Europe usually quote PS.

faqs.q: How do I convert BTU/h to watts?
faqs.a: Multiply BTU per hour by 0.29307107. A 12,000 BTU/h air conditioner is about 3,517 W (3.5 kW) of cooling power.

faqs.q: Is kW the same as kWh?
faqs.a: No. kW (kilowatt) is power — the rate of energy use. kWh (kilowatt-hour) is energy — 1 kW used for one hour. Your electricity bill charges kWh.

faqs.q: How many horsepower is a 2 kW motor?
Does the tool send my data anywhere?
faqs.a: No. All conversion happens inside your browser; nothing leaves your device.
